title: How Charlie Sykes Went From Right-Wing Commentator To a Never-Trumper Purged From Twitter
author: John Harwood
content:
Right-wing media personalities - like Tucker Carlson and Candace Owens - are
finally [turning against](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cz0ep709pr2o) U.S.
President Donald Trump, amid his reckless war on Iran and dipping poll
numbers.

But in this conversation, **Zeteo 's** John Harwood speaks to one of the first
conservative media personalities to speak out against Trump - Charlie Sykes,
whose Twitter posts were recently
[purged](https://www.mediaite.com/media/x-purges-charlie-sykes-account-after-
article-critical-of-elon-musk/), after publishing an article criticizing Elon
Musk.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

In this conversation, Sykes - one of The Bulwark's co-founders and author of
the Substack, ["To the Contrary"](https://charliesykes.substack.com/) - warns
that until MAGA is stopped from deforming America's identity, **" this is who
we are."**
